default.notes: A visitor's visa must be obtained from a Saint Lucian mission or honorary consulate before travelling — there is no visa on arrival and no eVisa.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enter under Caribbean Community free-movement arrangements — a definite entry of up to six months is granted on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism — an initial stay of about six weeks is granted on arrival, extendable by the Immigration Department up to six months.
Visa-free under Saint Lucia's waiver for Latin American passports — expect an initial stay of about six weeks, extendable in Castries.
Commonwealth citizens are admitted visa-free, normally with an initial stay of about six weeks that the Immigration Department can extend.
Visa-free under a bilateral waiver — confirm the current allowance with a Saint Lucian mission before a long stay.
Taiwan (ROC) passport holders enter visa-free — Saint Lucia is one of Taipei's diplomatic partners.
Commonwealth membership does not carry a visa waiver for this nationality — apply for a visitor's visa at a Saint Lucian mission before travelling.

LC.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Saint Lucian citizens.

CN.notes: Saint Lucia maintains diplomatic relations with Taiwan rather than Beijing — holders of PRC passports need a visa arranged in advance.
